exposure: Candida species (C. albicans, C. glabrata, C. krusei)
Antifungal susceptibility to fluconazole (FCZ), amphotericin B (AMB), itraconazole (ICZ), voriconazole (VCZ)
outcome: Antifungal susceptibility profile of Candida albicans
cohort: A total of 258 pregnant women with vaginal discharge at 35 to 37 weeks of gestation participated in this study.
finding: The study found a 39% prevalence of Candida species among symptomatic pregnant women in Beirut, with C. albicans significantly associated with gestational diabetes and non-C. albicans species with other gestational complications, while C. albicans showed high susceptibility to AMB and VCZ.
